mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) exceeding 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 falls > 2% YoY (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month acceleration in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which pressure corporate margins and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 2 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A six-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 3% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls > 3% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both the federal funds rate and CPI inflation above 2% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which increases discount rates and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL > 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) exceeding 1% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 falls > 1% over 2 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained six-month increase in the unemployment rate above 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which pressure corporate margins and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in both industrial production (INDPRO) and real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) exceeding 1% signals broad-based economic weakening, which reduces earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > 1% AND GDPC1 falls > 1% over 6 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO and GDPC1 fall > 1% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).
